paragraphs: I build end-to-end analytics: warehouse models, SQL transformation layers, automated data-quality checks and self-serve Tableau dashboards that give business teams a single trusted view of their numbers.

At Neiman Marcus Groups I unified 7 sources (OMS, POS, product master, marketplace reconciliation, marketing, customer and inventory) into one PostgreSQL warehouse with a star-schema model and slowly changing dimensions, and cut dashboard refresh times by ~50% through query tuning.

Before that I delivered claims analytics and reusable data-quality scripts at Baylor Scott & White, and at Relevance lab I reduced delivery time by 25% through shipment analysis and saved ~9 hours of manual work per week by automating reporting pipelines.

I care about numbers people can sign off on: I partner with finance, merchandising and marketing to define KPIs, validate every one against source data through UAT, and document schemas, lineage and logic for easy handoff.
